cells.gaps: The bureau is accredited to certify to ISO/IEC 27001:2022 (KEN-006), but no source says that standard is adopted as a Kenyan standard, or that anyone certifies against KS 3007 or another national standard on information technology or data.
cells.note: The Kenya Bureau of Standards, set up under the Standards Act in 1974 (KEN-004), has issued KS 3007, a code of practice for AI applications (KEN-005). Its July 2025 accreditation to certify to ISO/IEC 27001 (KEN-006) is against an international standard not shown to be national, so stage 4 is not met.
